Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo this morning - liked the throughput numbers and the canary/fallback story. Procurement and InfoSec have a couple of outstanding asks before we can move to a contract:

- Do you have a SOC 2 Type II report we can review? If the current cycle isn't complete, can you provide a bridge letter?

- We're starting the vendor security questionnaire (attached) - can you confirm who on your side should own responses and typical turnaround time?

We're trying to finalize vendor approvals this week. If you can route the SOC2/bridge letter and trust-portal invite to me and Kevin that would help speed things up.

Hi Sofia - great to meet you virtually earlier. Appreciate the clear list. Quick answers and proposed next steps: 

- SOC 2: We have a SOC 2 Type II report covering our inference platform through 2026-10-31. I'm confirming whether the 2027 cycle finished; if not, we will provide a bridge letter.
- Trust portal: We can create a read-only invite for your InfoSec team. Please confirm the email(s) you want added (Sofia/Kevin ok?).
- Questionnaire: happy to own the vendor security questionnaire. Neha will be primary on the answers; typical turnaround for a first pass is 48-72 hours depending on attachments.
- HIPAA/GDPR: We support HIPAA-covered workloads and can provide our HIPAA attestation and DPA language.

Proposed immediate steps: 
1) Please upload the filled questionnaire (or confirm the attached is the one you want us to use).
2) Confirm portal user emails for read-only access (we'll add SSO if you'd prefer).
3) I'll attach the bridge letter tonight and send a trust-portal invite URL.

If you need an accelerated path to close this week, let me know and we can route a bridge letter + portal access immediately.

Thanks - Marissa
